Velo Girls Melo Velo

Woodside, CA · Road

Women / trans / femmeBeginner friendly

Velo Girls Melo Velo is a road group ride in Woodside, CA. It rolls every Sunday at 9:00 am from Woodside Town Hall. About 15 miles, about 10 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 9:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 10 mph: you can talk the whole way.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Velo Girls Melo Velo group ride

A beginner-friendly Sunday ride for women and women-identifying riders: about 15 miles at around 10 mph from Woodside Town Hall. October 4, 18 and 25 are on the calendar. October 11 is canceled.
